segments.JAS.1.2-3: James says trials test faith and bring perseverance
segments.JAS.1.6-8: Believers must ask God in faith, without doubting
segments.JAS.1.12-12: A person who endures trials will receive the crown of life
segments.JAS.1.13-13: God does not tempt anyone to do evil
segments.JAS.1.14-16: Evil desires lead to sin and then to death
segments.JAS.1.17-18: God gives every good gift and gave us new birth
segments.JAS.1.19-21: James tells believers to listen first and accept God’s word
segments.JAS.1.22-25: James urges believers to do what the word says
segments.JAS.1.26-27: True religion controls the tongue and cares for the needy
segments.JAS.2.1-4: James warns believers not to favor rich people
segments.JAS.2.5-7: God chose the poor, but the church dishonored them
segments.JAS.2.8-9: Favoritism is sin, but loving your neighbor is right
segments.JAS.2.10-11: Breaking one part of the law makes a person guilty of all
segments.JAS.2.12-13: James tells believers to speak and act with mercy
segments.JAS.2.18-20: James says faith without deeds is worthless
segments.JAS.2.21-24: Abraham’s deeds showed that his faith was real
segments.JAS.2.25-26: Rahab’s actions show that faith needs deeds
segments.JAS.3.1-2: James warns that teachers will be judged more strictly
segments.JAS.3.5-6: The tongue is a small fire that harms the whole person
segments.JAS.3.7-8: No one can tame the tongue, but people tame animals
segments.JAS.3.9-10: Believers bless God and curse people with one mouth
segments.JAS.3.11-12: A spring cannot give both fresh water and salt water
segments.JAS.3.13-14: Wise people show good conduct, not bitter jealousy
segments.JAS.3.15-18: Earthly wisdom brings disorder; God’s wisdom brings peace
segments.JAS.4.1-3: Wrong desires cause quarrels among believers
segments.JAS.4.4-5: Friendship with the world makes believers enemies of God
segments.JAS.4.6-6: God gives grace to the humble but opposes the proud
segments.JAS.4.7-7: Believers should submit to God and resist the devil
segments.JAS.4.8-10: James urges sinners to come near to God and be humble
segments.JAS.4.11-12: Believers must not speak against or judge each other
segments.JAS.4.13-14: Life is like a mist, and no one knows tomorrow
segments.JAS.4.15-17: Believers should plan as the Lord wills and do right
segments.JAS.5.1-3: James warns rich people that misery is coming
segments.JAS.5.4-6: Rich people cheated workers and lived in luxury
segments.JAS.5.7-8: Believers should be patient until the Lord comes
segments.JAS.5.9-11: Believers should not complain but be patient like Job
segments.JAS.5.12-12: Believers should not swear oaths but speak simply
segments.JAS.5.13-15: Believers pray when in trouble; elders pray for the sick
segments.JAS.5.16-18: Believers should confess sins and pray like Elijah
